key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Low trailing/procumbent to decumbent herb, often under 15 cm tall; several-stemmed from the base.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Alternate; mostly arrow-shaped with backward-pointing basal lobes, but may become more broadly lobed; soft-hairy/velvety.

key_traits.label: Sepals
key_traits.text: Outer sepals roughly 7–7.5 mm in Williamson County material, rounded/cupped and densely hairy.

key_traits.label: Corolla
key_traits.text: Broadly funnel-shaped, around 15 mm long and about 20 mm across; white with pink/rose-toned panels.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Small capsule; calyx persists around fruit.
